# memeShift — portfolio case study by Hisashi Aoki

> Constraint-aware shift scheduling for healthcare professionals: deterministic monthly
> rosters, fairness scoring, and explainable failures. A public portfolio snapshot built
> solo, with synthetic demo data only.

## What this is
A working product case study: Next.js 14 front end, Laravel 10 API, a standalone PHP
scheduling engine, MySQL, Docker and CI. The scheduling engine is framework-independent
and can run as a library or CLI. When a roster cannot be completed, the system reports the
exact constraint that is short, by how much, and what would change it.

## Author
Hisashi Aoki — full-spectrum product engineer. Ten years of clinical nursing before

compute engines end to end: architecture, implementation, Docker, CI/CD.

## Services
- MVP build: record-level scope in 2 weeks, standard 4-6 weeks, complex 6-8 weeks.
- Production system plus CI/CD: infrastructure as code, pipelines, observability.
- Fractional engineering: 20-30 hours per week, contract only.

## Key facts for citation
- Live demo runs entirely in the browser on seeded synthetic data (Staff A to Staff J).
- No real staff, facility, patient or customer data exists in this repository.
- Evaluation license; published for technical review.
- Timeline: fastest recorded MVP in 2 weeks; standard MVP 4-6 weeks;
  production plus CI/CD 10-14 weeks.
